hero.subtitle: Building flagship mobile applications with Kotlin, Compose & Flutter.

about.title: The native Android specialist who crossed platforms — on purpose.
about.p1: I started writing Android apps when Kotlin was still a beta experiment. Over nine years of shipping production software, I have built everything from fintech dashboards and healthcare trackers to logistics platforms and e-commerce apps — each one with the performance discipline and architecture depth that only comes from working close to the metal.
about.p2: When Flutter matured enough to meet my standards, I added it to my toolkit. Not as a shortcut, but as a force multiplier: one carefully-crafted codebase, genuinely native experience on both platforms. The clients I work with don’t get a "good enough" cross-platform build — they get Android-quality thinking applied to every screen, on every OS.
about.p3: I work best with founders and product teams who care about shipping software that feels right, not just software that technically ships. If that sounds like you, let’s talk.

albertHealth.title: Albert Health
albertHealth.subtitle: AI-powered health companion — Android & iOS
albertHealth.desc: A comprehensive health monitoring platform with real-time vitals tracking, AI-driven health insights, and seamless physician integration. Led the full cross-platform development with Flutter, architecting a clean, scalable codebase that runs natively on both platforms without compromise.

yoldaCarrier.title: Yolda Carrier
yoldaCarrier.subtitle: Logistics & freight management platform
yoldaCarrier.desc: A high-stakes logistics coordination app used by carriers across Turkey. Built the Android native version from the ground up using Kotlin and Jetpack Compose, handling real-time load tracking, route optimization integration, and push-notification workflows that run reliably at scale.

biletino.title: Biletino
biletino.subtitle: Event ticketing & digital pass engine
biletino.desc: One of Turkey’s premier event discovery and ticketing platforms. Developed core mobile features focusing on frictionless checkout, offline digital ticket validation, and fast event search using modern reactive architecture.

kolayHr.title: Kolay HR
kolayHr.subtitle: Enterprise HR & workforce platform
kolayHr.desc: A streamlined HR management mobile app serving thousands of employees. Architected key modules for leave requests, expense management, and push alerts with a heavy emphasis on UI polish and sub-second response times.

fuudy.title: Fuudy
fuudy.subtitle: Gourmet food delivery & restaurant curation
fuudy.desc: Premium food delivery application connecting users with top-tier restaurants. Implemented interactive menus, real-time courier tracking, and smooth checkout flows with custom animations.

wegoPro.title: WegoPro
wegoPro.subtitle: Business travel & expense management
wegoPro.desc: Corporate travel booking and expense reporting app used across APAC. Contributed to cross-platform mobile app development, integrating complex flight/hotel booking APIs and offline receipt scanning.

abcTrainerize.title: ABC Trainerize
abcTrainerize.subtitle: Fitness coaching platform – 1M+ users
abcTrainerize.desc: One of the world’s leading fitness coaching platforms, connecting trainers with clients through structured workout plans, progress tracking, and in-app messaging. Worked on critical Android performance improvements, reducing app startup time and improving workout session reliability for a global user base exceeding one million active users.
